ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low; the macro-level ratio is heavily skewed toward low-intensity (dark) pixels with high-intensity (white) pixels limited to the distal tips and sparse surface spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: The visible surface displays uniform dark pigmentation; high-contrast contiguous geometric clusters are localized at the distal tips of both the left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: The visible portion of the central notch forms a V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 55 degrees; the vertex is partially submerged.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency serration along the continuous linear boundary of both lobes, characterized by irregular peaks and valleys isolated against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes exhibit a symmetrical convex curve trajectory sweeping from the central axis to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Detection of localized high-contrast white pixel clusters at the distal tips of both lobes, corresponding to barnacle colonization.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle encrustations at the tips of both lobes; small, isolated white punctate marks are visible on the surface of the right lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Extremely jagged and irregular trailing edge topography which is significantly more pronounced than standard species variations.
